name: B10-0379/2025 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Abdoul Aziz Goma, an Irish citizen held in Togo since December 2018. He was kept waiting for trial for over six years, then given a 10-year sentence in a one-day trial in February 2025. The Parliament says he has been tortured and denied food, healthcare and a lawyer, and that his health has badly worsened. It asks Togo to free him and improve its prisons and courts.

- The Parliament asks Togo to release Abdoul Aziz Goma immediately and unconditionally.
- It affects him, other prisoners in Lomé's overcrowded civil prison, and Togo's authorities.
- Next, the EU Commission and its office in Lomé are urged to push Togo for his release.
